hooks.command: CMD="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '(lib/provisioning|api/provisioning|api/teardown)' && echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '(curl|fetch|provision|teardown)'; then echo '[pre-provision hook] Checking Phase 2 budget cap before provisioning action'; fi; true
hooks.description: Pre-provision hook: flag provisioning actions for budget cap awareness

hooks.command: FILE_PATH="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$FILE_PATH" == *.ts || "$FILE_PATH" == *.tsx ]]; then timeout 60 npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile node_modules/.cache/tsc-hook.tsbuildinfo 2>&1 | tail -20; fi

FILE_PATH="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if echo "$FILE_PATH" | grep -q 'lib/provisioning/'; then echo "[post-provisioner hook] Provisioner file edited: $FILE_PATH — run tests: npx vitest run $FILE_PATH"; fi; true
hooks.description: Post-provision hook: remind to run tests after editing a provisioner

hooks.command: git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | xargs grep -l 'console\.log' 2>/dev/null | while read f; do echo "[hook] console.log found in $f"; done; true
hooks.description: Warn about console.log in modified files at session end

hooks.command: PROVISIONERS=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep 'lib/provisioning/' | grep -v '.test.' | head -5); if [ -n "$PROVISIONERS" ]; then echo "[session-end hook] Phase 3 provisioners modified this session:"; echo "$PROVISIONERS"; echo "[session-end hook] Reminder: real-provider validation required before ship (no mocks sufficient)"; fi; true
hooks.description: Session-end: remind about real-provider validation for modified provisioners
